topicTitle: Derivatives: derivative of a function, derivatives of algebraic, trigonometric, inverse trigonometric, exponential and logarithmic functions by definition (simple forms)
notes: **Fact.** Derivative f'(x) = lim_{h→0} [f(x+h) − f(x)]/h = tangent slope; rules: sum, product, quotient, chain.
**Fact.** d/dx xⁿ = nx^{n−1}; d/dx sin x = cos x; d/dx e^x = e^x; d/dx ln x = 1/x.
**Fact.** Higher-order derivatives: y'' (concavity), y''' etc. Critical points f' = 0 → possible extrema (2nd-derivative test).
